name: Booth Bandits
tagline: Fresh baked goods from Columbus, Indiana. Find our next show or request a custom cake.
about: We're a small vendor table you'll find at gun shows and pop-up markets around Indiana. Everything we bring is new or made by us. Our cakes, cupcakes and cookies are baked in Columbus, IN under our CJ's Cakes name, and we're ServSafe certified. We also take custom cake orders for birthdays, showers and weddings, with delivery or curbside pickup around Columbus, Seymour, Greensburg, North Vernon, Vernon, Hope, Edinburgh, Nashville and Bloomington.

admission.freeFor: Kids 12 and under get in free
admission.where: You pay the show at the front door, not us. Once you're in, walking the tables is free.
admission.note: Most county shows are $6; the big expo shows cost more. The show organizer sets the price and who gets in free.

dealerNote: We sell goods, not guns. We're a vendor at these shows, not a licensed firearms dealer, and we don't buy, sell or transfer firearms.
